26:61.text: And when the two companies saw one another, the companions of Moses said, "Indeed, we are to be overtaken!"

26:62.text: said, "No! Indeed, with me is my Lord; He will guide me."

26:63.text: Then We inspired to Moses, "Strike with your staff the sea," and it parted, and each portion was like a great towering mountain.

26:64.text: And We advanced thereto the others

26:65.text: And We saved Moses and those with him, all together.

26:67.text: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.

26:68.text: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

26:69.text: And recite to them the news of Abraham,

26:70.text: When he said to his father and his people, "What do you worship?"

26:71.text: They said, "We worship idols and remain to them devoted."

26:72.text: He said, "Do they hear you when you supplicate?

26:73.text: Or do they benefit you, or do they harm?"

26:74.text: They said, "But we found our fathers doing thus."

26:75.text: He said, "Then do you see what you have been worshipping,

26:77.text: Indeed, they are enemies to me, except the Lord of the worlds,

26:79.text: And it is He who feeds me and gives me drink.

26:80.text: And when I am ill, it is He who cures me

26:81.text: And who will cause me to die and then bring me to life

26:82.text: And who I aspire that He will forgive me my sin on the Day of Recompense."

26:83.text: , "My Lord, grant me authority and join me with the righteous.
